newsitem.title: UK: Major British motorway closed by security alert.
newsitem.headline: Major British motorway closed by security alert.

text.p: British police closed two of the busiest sections of the motorway around London on Tuesday after a security alert.

Police declined to say if they had received a coded warning but the closures on the busy M25 London ring road followed a spate of bomb attacks and alerts by the Irish Republican Army, which is fighting to oust Britain from Northern Ireland.
Police said later that a stretch of the M1, the major artery linking London to northern England, had also been closed, paralysing traffic in the morning rush hour.

The IRA, whose guerrilla actions have provoked traffic chaos on motorways and railways and at airports, is bidding to put Northern Ireland high on the political agenda in the run-up to Britain's general election on Thursday.
